9.    Present Zoning District: B3-2 and B2-2        Proposed Zoning District: B2-2

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions): 13,845 sq. ft. (130 ft. by 106.5 ft.)

11.   Current Use of the Property: The subiect propertv is currently improved v^th a three-storv
      mixed-use building that the Applicant is proposing to rehabilitate and renovate.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: To establish a uniform underlying zoning district and
      permit the rehabilitation and renovation of the existing three-storv building to contain two
      (2) retail units at grade and six (6) residential units above.

13.   Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to rehabilitate and renovate the existing three-storv building and establish it as a mixed-use
      building with two (2) retail units at grade level and six (6) residential unit above. The
      retails units will contain 1,268 sq. ft. and 1,545 sq. ft. of floor area, respectivelv. The
      existing building's footprint and height dimension will remain without change. The mixed-
      use building will be supported by ten (10) surface parking spaces located on the south side
      of the subiect zoning lot.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing tmits
      and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to
